limitations: No Havok pose evaluation, engine simulation or in-game test.
Read-only spawn graph covers HitBulletID and intervalCreateBulletId; dynamic AI/HKS/event and FXR spawning are not exhaustively proved.
Hit-list sharing is a data flag, not proof that all roots share one damage cooldown.

Effect closure covers native NPC residents and selected effect-add event types plus four explicit effect-chain links; conditional runtime applications can add others.
